title: Prime Focus Q2 FY27: Strong Revenue & Profit Growth Amidst VFX Boom
description: Prime Focus reported a significant revenue increase to ₹1,410.17 crore in Q2 FY27, up 35.2% year-on-year. Net profit surged to ₹58.27 crore, a substantial imp.

faq.q: What is the "Ramayana effect" mentioned in relation to Prime Focus's results?
faq.a: The "Ramayana effect" likely refers to a boost in visual effects demand stemming from large-scale, high-budget projects, possibly mythological or epic in nature, which require extensive VFX work.

faq.q: How did Prime Focus's Q2 FY27 net profit compare to previous periods?
faq.a: Prime Focus reported a net profit of ₹58.27 crore in Q2 FY27, a significant increase from ₹4.06 crore in Q2 FY26 and a strong turnaround from a ₹45.78 crore loss in Q1 FY27.

faq.q: What was Prime Focus's revenue growth in Q2 FY27?
faq.a: The company's revenue rose to ₹1,410.17 crore in Q2 FY27, marking a 35.2% increase year-on-year, driven by strong visual effects demand.

faq.q: What is the significance of the Income Tax Department searches?
faq.a: Income Tax Department searches, as per the Income Tax Act, 1961, are conducted when there's reason to suspect undisclosed income. For investors, this introduces uncertainty and potential risk, requiring close monitoring of the investigation's outcome.

faq.q: Does strong performance guarantee future stock price appreciation?
faq.a: No, strong financial performance is a positive indicator but does not guarantee future stock price appreciation. Market sentiment, industry trends, macroeconomic factors, and any new developments (like regulatory investigations) also play a crucial role.
